S. Hierom. ( Epiſt. ad Marcellamo vt migret Bethleem. ) Haue recourſe tor
Geneſis, and you ſhal find Melchiſedech king of Salem, prince of this citie,
who euen then in figure of Chriſt offered bread and wine, and dedicated the
Chriſtian myſterie in our Sauiours bod e and bloud: Idem Epiſt. ad Euagrium :
Melchiſedech offered not bloudie victims, but dedicated the Sacrament of
Chriſt in bread and wine, ſimple and puire ſacrifice: Idem: Queſt. in Gen. c.
14: Our myſterie is ſignified in the word of order, not by Aaron in imolating
brute victims, but inoffering bread and wine, that is the bodie and bloud of
our Lord Iefus. Idem in c. 26. Matthei : Melchiſedech the Prieſt of God moſt:
hiegh, by offering bread and wine, prefigured the Myſterie of the Euchariſt.

the veritie: ho. 36. After that Melchiſedec king of Salem brought bread and
wine ( for he was Prieſt of God moſt hiegh) Abraham receiued his oblations.
